neighbours.label: Atom counts and fragments written inside chemical formulas and systematic chemical names in chemistry text (C2H5OH, C8H10N4O2, -nonylphenol); quiet when the same compounds are named in plain words.
fire: Aspirin, with the formula C9H8O4, is made from salicylic acid and acetic anhydride.
In the reaction, propane C3H8 burns in oxygen to give carbon dioxide and water.
Table sugar is sucrose, C12H22O11, a disaccharide of glucose and fructose.
Sulfuric acid, H2SO4, reacts with zinc to release hydrogen gas in the flask.
The detergent contained 4-octylphenol and several branched alkyl sulfonates.
Nicotine has the empirical formula C10H14N2 and is an alkaloid found in tobacco.
The ester ethyl acetate, CH3COOC2H5, gives nail polish remover its smell.
Under acid conditions the carboxylate, -COO-, becomes the neutral acid -COOH.
quiet: Aspirin is made by treating salicylic acid with acetic anhydride and warming it.
In the reaction, propane burns in oxygen to give carbon dioxide and water vapor.
Table sugar is sucrose, a disaccharide built from one glucose and one fructose.
Strong acids react with zinc to release hydrogen gas, which bubbles in the flask.
The detergent contained several surfactants that help lift grease from fabric.
Nicotine is an alkaloid found in tobacco leaves and it is highly addictive.
The ester called ethyl acetate gives nail polish remover its sharp sweet smell.
Under acid conditions the charged group picks up a proton and becomes neutral.

predictions: median fire ~0.5 (probes: C2H5OH '5' 0.60, caffeine formula 0.57, nonylphenol 0.63, -NH3+ 0.38); near misses < 0.1 (formula-like locker code 0.098, plain chemistry prose ~0.01-0.03).
notes: Probed: a formula outside chemistry ('locker code is C2H5') scored only 0.098, so the unit needs a chemical setting, not just letter-digit strings.
